mapper.select: /* 커뮤니티 (공지사항) 첨부파일 조회 쿼리 (selectAttachFileList)*/ select ATCH_FILE_ID as atchFileId , FILE_SEQ as fileSeq , ORG_FILE_NM as orgFileNm , SAVE_FILE_NM as saveFileNm , FILE_PATH as filePath , FILE_SIZE as fileSize , FILE_EXT as fileExt , to_char(TO_DATE(REG_DT,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') as reqDt from ocuoc_atchf_m where ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId} order by FILE_SEQ

/* 커뮤니티 (공지사항) 상세 조회 쿼리 (selectNoticeDetail)*/ select NOTICE_SEQNO as "noticeSeqno" ,NOTICE_TTL as "noticeTtl" ,NOTICE_CN as "noticeCn" ,VIEW_CNT as "viewCnt" ,USE_YN as "useYn" ,NOTICE_MSG_DVCD as "noticeMsgDvcd" ,NOTICE_TYPE_CD as "noticeTypeCd" ,FAQ_ANSMER as "faqAnsmer" ,to_char(TO_DATE(STDD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') as "stdd" ,to_char(TO_DATE(ENDT,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') as "endt" ,ATCH_FILE_ID as "atchFileId" ,LAST_CHNG_EMPNO as "lastChngEmpno" from ocuoc_notic_m where NOTICE_SEQNO = #{noticeSeqno} and NOTICE_TYPE_CD = #{noticeTypeCd}

select ATCH_FILE_ID as atchFileId , FILE_SEQ as fileSeq , ORG_FILE_NM as orgFileNm , SAVE_FILE_NM as saveFileNm , FILE_PATH as filePath , FILE_SIZE as fileSize , FILE_EXT as fileExt , to_char(TO_DATE(REG_DT,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') as reqDt from ocuoc_atchf_m where ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId} and FILE_SEQ = #{fileSeq}
